definitions.gloss: stroll; ramble; leisurely walk without a destination
definitions.explanation: Walking around aimlessly and at a relaxed pace, enjoying the surroundings rather than heading toward a specific goal. A somewhat literary word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漫歩|まんぽ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漫歩|まんぽ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a leisurely walk through the park in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漫歩|まんぽ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{醍醐味|だいごみ}→醍醐味：14412_daigomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The real pleasure of travel is forgetting about work and strolling through foreign alleyways.

notes:
Composed of {漫|まん} (aimless, rambling) + {歩|ぽ} (walk, step). A literary and somewhat refined word for walking without purpose.

USAGE:
{漫歩|まんぽ} is used primarily in written language — essays, travel writing, and literary descriptions. In everyday conversation, ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧ or ⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ are more natural. {漫歩|まんぽ} emphasizes the aimless, unhurried quality of the walk more than ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧ does.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{漫歩|まんぽ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stroll through a town
- {漫歩|まんぽ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy a stroll
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧{漫歩|まんぽ}: urban strolling
- {漫歩|まんぽ}{記|き}: rambling notes, strolling diary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: walk, stroll — the everyday word for taking a walk; can be purposeful (exercise, dog walking) or leisurely
- ⟦{散策|さんさく}→散策：07618_sansaku⟧: leisurely walk, exploring on foot — similar in register to {漫歩|まんぽ}, but implies more active looking around and exploring
- ⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to wander around — casual, conversational expression for aimless walking
